title: Mine Treasure + Stellarity Patch
description: Compatibility patch letting Mine Treasure and Stellarity coexist on End Stone loot
body:
# Mine Treasure + Stellarity Patch

A small compatibility datapack that makes **Mine Treasure** and **Stellarity** play nicely together.

## What it does

Without this patch, Mine Treasure and Stellarity conflict on End Stone's loot table —
only one of them wins. This patch merges both:

- End Stone retains Mine Treasure's high-tier treasure drops
- End Stone also has a chance to drop Stellarity's **Enderite Shards** (2% base,
  scales with Fortune)

## Installation

1. Install [Mine Treasupack/mine-treasure) and
   [Stellarity](https://modrinth.com/datapack/stellarity) first
2. Drop `mt-stellarity-patch.zip` into your world's `datapacks/` folder
3. Run `/reload`

Both base datapacks are **required**.
